neuron.title: Neuropet – Neuro-sama Screen Pet (Fan-made HUD Mascot)

addon_description.en: Between zombie fights, tiny Neuro-sama walks, trots, crawls and climbs around your screen, hangs from the top, and sometimes rests, falls, trips or hugs.
addon_description.zh-CN: 打僵尸的间隙，小小的 Neuro-sama 在屏幕边缘走走、爬爬、挂着休息，偶尔松手跌落、绊一跤，或者停下来抱抱。
